name: Carbone
description: Generate PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint documents from your templates and data.

disclaimer.text: This agent uses AI to prepare templates, data and documents. AI-generated content may be inaccurate: review every document before you share or send it. To report harmful or inappropriate content, email support@carbone.io.

conversation_starters.title: Fill my invoice template
conversation_starters.text: Fill my Invoice template for Northwind Traders: 3 consulting days at 850 EUR and 1 training session at 1200 EUR, issued today, due in 30 days.

conversation_starters.title: Quote from deal notes
conversation_starters.text: Create a PDF quote with page numbers from these deal notes: Contoso Ltd, 25 Pro licenses at 49 USD per month for 12 months, 10% discount, valid until the end of next month.

conversation_starters.title: My template library
conversation_starters.text: Show my stored templates by category, with their tags and the fields each one expects.

conversation_starters.title: Certificates for a list
conversation_starters.text: Create a PDF training certificate for each person: Alice Martin, Bruno Costa, Chen Wei. Course: Data Privacy Basics, completed on 2026-10-15.

conversation_starters.title: Confidential PDF
conversation_starters.text: Render my Invoice template with its stored sample data as a PDF with a CONFIDENTIAL watermark and an open password that I will give you.

conversation_starters.title: Reusable offer letter
conversation_starters.text: Design a reusable offer letter template with candidate name, job title, start date and salary, show me a sample PDF, then save it to my library.

conversation_starters.title: New template version
conversation_starters.text: Open my Invoice template, add a payment terms line under the total, and save it as a new version.

conversation_starters.title: Organize a template
conversation_starters.text: Add the tags billing and 2026 to my Invoice template and move it to the finance category.

conversation_starters.title: French and English versions
conversation_starters.text: Generate my Invoice template in French and in English from its sample data, with local date and amount formats.

conversation_starters.title: Markdown to Word
conversation_starters.text: Convert this Markdown to a Word document: # Q3 review - Revenue up 12 percent - Two new clients signed - Next step: hire a sales lead

conversation_starters.title: Fix empty fields
conversation_starters.text: My document shows an empty client name. The tag is {d.customer.name} and my data has client.name. What is wrong and how do I fix it?

conversation_starters.title: What my account supports
conversation_starters.text: Check that the Carbone service is up, then list the output formats, converters and PDF options I can use.
